content:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOYBOT] Hotfix scheduled: inference-frontend -> v2.3.1.patch
Reason: tokenizer returns malformed token for empty/whitespace-only inputs causing 502s in prod (2.7% of requests over the last 8m).
Action: expedited rollout with pin to dedicated pool and 4-stage stagger (2m each).
Suggested command:
```/deploy start --service=inference-frontend --image=registry.redwood/v2.3.1.patch --env=prod --pin=dedicated-pool-2 --stagger=2m --gates=health,latency``` 
maria: oncall, tagging infra/eng. Need rollback plan, blast radius, and release note snippet.
jordan: dev here—rollback is simple: redeploy v2.3.0 (no DB change). Blast radius: endpoints /predict and /chat-short only; TTL caches fine.
lina: QA verified fix in canary for 30m. Perf looks stable. No schema changes. +1 from eng.
ben: infra—capacity ok, pre-warming nodes now. Recommend health-check window 30s and fail fast if >1% 5xx aggregated.
oliver: release comms—please provide 1-line note for release notes and changelog.
maria: rollback plan acknowledged. jordan, post smoke logs and confirm traces look normal.
jordan: running quick smoke:
```for i in {1..60}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://prod-inference.redwood/api/v1/predict -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"text":" "}'; done``` 
jordan: smoke 60/60 200s, median latency 140ms. traces linked: https://traces.redwood/trace/1755554321
ben: infra pre-warm complete. Starting staged rollout. Monitoring CPU/gpu and node pool size.
deploy-bot: Rollout started by @maria. Stage duration 2m per shard. Health gate: 1 successful probe per shard, p95 < 350ms threshold.
maria: if error rate or p95 > threshold, abort and revert immediately. Everyone ack?
lina: ack :thumbsup: 
ben: ack :thumbsup: 
jordan: ack :thumbsup: 
oliver: ack, will draft release blurb.
maria: oliver post the blurb here when ready.
oliver: release note: "v2.3.1.patch — Fix tokenizer edge-case: empty/whitespace inputs producing 502s. Expedited hotfix; pinned to dedicated pool."
maria: noted. deploy-bot reports: stage1 ok at 1755554390, stage2 ok at 1755554510 (no anomalies).
jordan: monitoring logs/metrics; small spike in p50 during stage2 but within limits.
ben: stage3 and stage4 complete, deploy-bot: rolled out to 100% at 1755554480. Audit link: https://audit.redwood/deploys/1755554321
maria: closing thread. If anything crops up open an incident and tag #postmortems. thanks all.
